description: Create source-backed GCSE, IGCSE, A-Level, and College Board AP revision handbooks from official AQA, Edexcel, CAIE, and College Board sources.
systems_doctrine: A handbook is deliverable only when its source, teaching, visual, review, and delivery states form one current evidence chain.

boundary_map.owned_job: Acquire official curriculum evidence, decompose it into atomic teaching points, write subject-specific teaching and practice, select and review educational visuals, render and personally review HTML, and export a hash-bound PDF only after approval.
input_boundary: A complete preflight covering board or provider, qualification, A-Level stage when applicable, market, subject, exam year, language, work mode, batch scope, and output directory.
An explicit user answer about external image-generation capability plus a verified callable route when one is selected.
Official source evidence, or a user-accepted experimental manual import for unsupported curricula.
boundary_map.output_boundary: For each subject, one controlled handbook bundle containing current source evidence, atomic outline, teaching content, visual manifest and assets, approved HTML, review ledger, PDF, delivery copy, and matching hashes.
non_goals: Automatic official-source acquisition for curricula outside the declared AQA, Edexcel, CAIE, and College Board AP routes.
Using Python, keyword rules, templates, or machine diagnostics to decide syllabus meaning, teaching content, visual semantics, or approval.
Exporting a PDF before complete LLM review and approval of the exact current HTML.
Sharing sampled review conclusions, outlines, approvals, or artifact state between batch subjects.
constraints: Block every downstream phase until preflight is complete and the selected image route is verified.
Keep LLM-owned semantic decisions separate from Python-owned extraction, validation, rendering, recording, and blocking.
Preserve rebuild, import assets, approve visuals, then render-only ordering.
Invalidate every downstream artifact and approval when an upstream input hash changes.
Review and repair the complete visible HTML until the current render and ledger hashes pass before PDF export.
Run the full evidence and review chain independently for every subject in a batch.
human_judgment_boundary: Confirm the complete preflight and verify the selected image route before starting any downstream work.
Resolve official provider, market, qualification, stage, course, and year ambiguity instead of guessing or substituting.
Let the LLM decide syllabus meaning, atomic teaching points, teaching content, visual route, semantic correctness, and approval.
Require complete review of the exact current HTML and matching evidence hashes before authorizing PDF export.
Review every batch subject independently and never approve from a sample or another subject's state.

feedback_loops.name: Preflight gate loop
feedback_loops.signal: A required field is missing, ambiguous, inferred, or the selected image route has not been called successfully.
feedback_loops.response: Stop, ask only for the missing decision, verify the route, and invalidate any prematurely created downstream artifacts.

feedback_loops.name: Syllabus granularity loop
feedback_loops.signal: A final topic maps only to a broad Topic or Unit container, lacks an independently assessable source requirement, or merges requirements without a teaching reason.
feedback_loops.response: Return to official evidence, rebuild the atomic mapping, and re-audit source coverage before writing.
feedback_loops.evidence: official requirement -> atomic point -> final topic -> visible handbook location mapping

feedback_loops.name: Visual semantics loop
feedback_loops.signal: A planned or rendered visual does not express a topic-specific structure, relationship, quantity, process, or spatial meaning, or contains incorrect labels, arrows, units, or relationships.
feedback_loops.response: Reject the visual, revise its medium and source-bound specification, regenerate or replace it, and perform LLM semantic review again.
feedback_loops.evidence: visual manifest, visual specification, rendered asset, and per-visual review decision

feedback_loops.name: State invalidation loop
feedback_loops.signal: A manifest rebuild, imported asset, outline, teaching input, visual decision, HTML, render snapshot, ledger, PDF, or delivery hash changes.
feedback_loops.response: Invalidate every dependent approval and rebuild the chain from the earliest changed input using rebuild -> import -> approve -> render-only order.
feedback_loops.evidence: artifact hashes and approval state ledger

feedback_loops.name: HTML repair loop
feedback_loops.signal: Complete visible LLM review finds a factual, teaching, visual, layout, encoding, or traceability defect in the current HTML.
feedback_loops.response: Rewrite or repair the defect, rerender, inspect the complete new HTML, and repeat until the exact current hashes are approved.
feedback_loops.evidence: HTML hash, render snapshot hash, item-level review ledger, screenshot locations, and repair round

feedback_loops.name: Delivery and batch loop
feedback_loops.signal: Any subject has pending, rejected, stale, missing, shared, or mismatched state before export or delivery.
feedback_loops.response: Block PDF and batch completion for that subject, repair its own chain, then verify the approved PDF and delivery-copy hashes.
feedback_loops.evidence: per-subject approval, PDF provenance, delivery audit, and batch completion matrix

drift_watch.name: Preflight bypass
drift_watch.watch_signal: An agent starts retrieval, analysis, writing, or visuals before the structured preflight and image-route decision are complete.
drift_watch.countermeasure: Make preflight state the first blocking transition and invalidate all artifacts created before it.

drift_watch.name: Broad-topic decomposition
drift_watch.watch_signal: The outline stops at Topic or Unit headings instead of independently assessable atomic teaching points.
drift_watch.countermeasure: Require the source-to-atomic-to-topic-to-location table and a coverage audit before writing.

drift_watch.name: Manifest and approval order drift
drift_watch.watch_signal: Approval is recorded before a manifest rebuild or asset import, causing assets or decisions to disappear or reset.
drift_watch.countermeasure: Enforce rebuild -> import -> approve -> render-only and reject out-of-order transitions.

drift_watch.name: Stale artifact hashes
drift_watch.watch_signal: HTML, render evidence, approvals, PDF, or delivery copies refer to different input versions.
drift_watch.countermeasure: Invalidate downstream state on every upstream hash change and audit the complete chain before export.

drift_watch.name: Semantic visual regression
drift_watch.watch_signal: Decorative text cards, repeated SVG templates, or polished but incorrect images are accepted as explanatory visuals.
drift_watch.countermeasure: Require topic-specific graphical objects and item-level LLM semantic review of the rendered asset.

drift_watch.name: Sampled batch review
drift_watch.watch_signal: One subject's outline, visual decision, HTML approval, or sampled result is reused to approve another subject.
drift_watch.countermeasure: Maintain independent subject state and block batch completion until every subject has its own current evidence chain.

failure_pattern_map.symptom: The agent invents an image route or starts work before all user decisions are locked.
failure_pattern_map.repair: Return to preflight, verify the selected route, and invalidate premature work.

failure_pattern_map.symptom: Broad source containers become final handbook topics without independently assessable requirements.
failure_pattern_map.repair: Rebuild the atomic evidence map and repeat the coverage audit before writing.

failure_pattern_map.symptom: Python, keywords, quotas, or templates decide teaching content or visual meaning.
failure_pattern_map.repair: Move semantic decisions back to the LLM and retain Python only for deterministic support and gates.

failure_pattern_map.symptom: An SVG, PNG, or JPG is accepted because the file exists even though it lacks correct teaching meaning.
failure_pattern_map.repair: Judge the rendered relationship, structure, quantity, or space; reject and redesign semantically weak visuals.

failure_pattern_map.symptom: Old and new manifests, assets, approvals, HTML, PDFs, or delivery copies are mixed.
failure_pattern_map.repair: Invalidate from the earliest changed input and rebuild one current evidence chain.

failure_pattern_map.symptom: Machine checks or a partial HTML sample are treated as LLM approval.
failure_pattern_map.repair: Perform full visible review and repair of the current HTML, then record hash-bound item-level evidence.

failure_pattern_map.symptom: Multiple subjects share one review conclusion or approval state.
failure_pattern_map.repair: Invalidate the shared conclusion and complete each subject independently.

leverage_points.why: Every later artifact depends on course identity, market, year, and the real image route.
leverage_points.move: Prevent downstream state creation until the complete preflight is valid.

leverage_points.point: Make atomic mapping an approved artifact
leverage_points.why: Teaching, practice, visuals, and source coverage all inherit outline granularity.
leverage_points.move: Approve the source-to-atomic-to-topic-to-location map before writing.

leverage_points.why: Correct content still fails when rebuilds erase assets or approvals refer to stale versions.
leverage_points.move: Use rebuild -> import -> approve -> render-only and propagate every hash invalidation.

leverage_points.why: A valid image file can still be visually empty, generic, or factually wrong.
leverage_points.move: Require per-visual LLM semantic review of the rendered asset against its source-bound specification.

leverage_points.point: Bind delivery to complete HTML review
leverage_points.why: PDF generation freezes defects and can hide stale approval state.
leverage_points.move: Export only from the exact current HTML and ledger hashes after the full repair loop passes.

reviewer_rule: Approve only when one current, per-subject evidence chain proves complete preflight, atomic source coverage, LLM-owned semantics, reviewed visuals, fully repaired HTML, and hash-bound PDF delivery.
